Approach to engagement: Frequent and formal contact to seek input, and guidance, present material for final review, and seek acceptance and endorsement of recommendations.
Frequent and more informal contact to seek input and guidance and assistance in forming key directions and recommendations.
Initial consultation followed up with structured outward communications at appropriate intervals to advise on process and outcomes.

May be managed through mass media or online questionnaires and surveying techniques. These enable publication of material such as a summary of the eHealth vision, and seek input from the general public through a questionnaire, poll or survey.
Generally, face-to-face consultations with the general public are not required during the development of the national eHealth vision and action plan, although public consultation forums can be used if needed.
